explanation: In Germany, dining etiquette emphasizes quiet and controlled eating; loud slurping of noodles is considered impolite and a sign of poor manners. Unlike in some East Asian cultures where slurping signals appreciation, in Germany it disrupts the meal's decorum and may draw disapproving looks.
local_tip: If you must eat noodles, twirl them quietly on your fork and take small, silent bites.

also_check.note: Slurping noodles is a compliment to the chef and enhances flavor.
Slurping is common and shows enjoyment, especially with noodles.
Slurping pasta is considered very impolite and uncivilized.
